title: Hatsune Miku — Profile Story

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for coming to the show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm happy I can sing for you today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I only have a few songs prepared.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But they're all precious songs that you've given to me.
I'll sing each and every one with all my heart and soul!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So be sure to join in!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can tell you all can't wait to start!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Without further ado...
Let the music begin!
